summary.text: Lisa Subeck is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 79 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican John Fons.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as teacher.

paragraphs.text: Lisa Subeck's professional experience includes working as a preschool teacher and as a program coordinator for YWCA Madison.
Subeck served on the Madison Common Council, District 1, from 2011 to 2015.
Ballotpedia gives her Assembly tenure as beginning in 2015.
Her 2025-2026 committee assignments are listed as Assembly Organization, Energy and Utilities, Health, and Rules.
